headline_marked: Trunk Tools [[cuts document review from 60 days to 10]] with AI stack
headline: Trunk Tools cuts document review from 60 days to 10 with AI stack
summary: Trunk Tools uses a 3-layer AI architecture to automate construction project management, reducing review cycles from months to days.
details: Trunk Tools, a construction project management company, has developed a specialized AI stack to automate industry-specific workflows. Their 3-layer architecture consists of perception, semantics, and agents, which enables high-accuracy and relevant automation.
The company's AI stack has reduced document review cycles from 60 days to just 10 days, prevented costly field errors, and allowed autonomous agents to reason over millions of pages of documentation.

General-purpose large language models (LLMs) often struggle with domain-specific tasks, as they are optimized for breadth rather than depth. Trunk Tools' approach could serve as a blueprint for transforming data chaos into agent-ready, industry-specific workflows in other verticals.
caption:
